findings.title: SignalWire FreeSWITCH SIP MESSAGE command injection advisory GHSA-mg63-h38w-8p9p (CVE-2026-116779)
findings.summary_md: SignalWire published advisory GHSA-mg63-h38w-8p9p on October 28, 2026 for CVE-2026-116779, a critical command injection in FreeSWITCH versions through 1.11.2. An inbound SIP MESSAGE can select the API chat protocol and run FreeSWITCH API and OS commands; the flaw carries CVSS 9.8 and the advisory notes exploitation in the wild. Fixed in FreeSWITCH 1.11.3.

findings.title: GPUStack authentication bypass exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-102895)
findings.summary_md: Ostorlab reported on November 5, 2026 that GPUStack versions before 2.2.0 contain an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-102895, CVSS 9.8) through a trusted loopback source or a forged X-GPUStack-Real-IP header, granting unauthenticated administrative access on GPU worker nodes. The vendor reported exploitation in the wild against a 2.1.1 deployment. Fixed in 2.2.0.

findings.title: Alpine Linux OpenSSH password authentication bypass advisory (CVE-2026-123158, sshole)
findings.summary_md: Alpine Linux published an OpenSSH advisory on November 5, 2026 covering CVE-2026-123158, nicknamed sshole by researcher Özgün Kültekin. The flaw lets an attacker reach sshd and authenticate to a passwordless account using any password between 257 and 1024 bytes on musl-based systems with PAM disabled. Fixed packages were released the same day in OpenSSH 10.6p2.

findings.title: IBM Aspera Faspex incorrect authorization advisory (CVE-2026-123218)
findings.summary_md: nFlo reported on November 7, 2026 that IBM Aspera Faspex 5.0.0 through 5.0.19 contains an incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-123218, CVSS 9.8) letting an authorized user craft a specific message to bypass authorization and gain full administrative privileges. IBM is the CNA and the vendor advisory is confirmed. Fixed in 5.0.19 PL1.
